name: Allient Inc.
summary: Allient Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and sells precision and specialty-controlled motion components and systems for various industries in the United States, Canada, South America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific. The company offers various products and solutions, including nano precision positioning systems; servo control systems; motion controllers; digital servo amplifiers and drives; brushless servo; torque; coreless motors, brush motors, integrated motor-drives, gear motors, gearing, incremental and absolute optical encoders, and active electronic and passive magnetic filters for power quality and harmonic issues; industrial safety rated input/output modules;…
